analysis_timing: Supplement requested after E18 outcomes were inspected; no new confirmatory data
ci_policy_exception: The user's E18.1 request explicitly authorizes confidence intervals and question-cluster bootstrap for this stage

bootstrap.rng: numpy PCG64 via SeedSequence child streams
bootstrap.unit: original question, with all four policies and all three generation records retained together
bootstrap.subtask_intervals: fixed-size paired question bootstrap inside each of the 27 BBH subtasks

interaction.effect: BBH question-mean TSPO-SPO gain minus GSM8K question-mean TSPO-SPO gain
interaction.test: two-sided Welch t on paired within-question policy differences, Satterthwaite degrees of freedom
interaction.bootstrap: difference of the same two task-specific paired bootstrap means

multiplicity.intervals: individual marginal 95% intervals, without simultaneous coverage claims
multiplicity.existing_tests: retain E18 primary two-sided p and its five-secondary Holm family unchanged
multiplicity.subtask_tests: diagnostic raw p and descriptive Holm-27 adjustment; no model selection

inference_scope: Question-sampling approximation conditional on frozen models, current task-source mixture and the three recorded generation repeats; the fully observed finite-pool mean is already known
missing_questions: two BBH input-reference incompatibilities remain excluded from bootstrap; E18 deterministic missing-outcome bounds remain separately labeled
public_data_rule: deidentified aggregate tables, code and evidence summaries only; IDs, answer arrays, weights and bootstrap replicate artifacts stay private
